name: Ōra (Japan)
description: A orange field charged at the centre with the Ōra town emblem in navy and yellow: a navy triangle with curved sides bearing a yellow ring.
history: Municipal flag of Ōra, a town in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1972.

features.role: Ōra town emblem — a navy triangle with curved sides bearing a yellow ring
